_notes.purpose: Final paper-level SMAC config applied identically to all three record types. The subfamily runner iterates record types from its --record-types CLI flag; this file only documents the (identical) SMAC settings used for each.
_notes.budget: Enforced budget is n_loops (SMAC runcount-limit); time_budget_sec is provenance only.
_notes.k_range: null = AutoML4Clust default [2, n/10], clamped for tiny datasets. Set e.g. [2, 50] to bound runtime if the default n/10 (hundreds of clusters on these datasets) is too slow.
_notes.fairness: AutoML4Clust receives only the partition space. No true labels, no true K, no metric utilities, no family metadata.
